# API Contracts

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

This repository is an Android client application with no inbound HTTP server; external interfaces consist of Android system intent/service contracts, outbound `HttpURLConnection` requests, and persisted JSON widget records.

### Android intents and system contracts

| Component / Caller | Intent / Binding | Parameters / Extras / Permissions | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MainActivity` | `android.intent.action.MAIN` (`HOME`, `DEFAULT`, `LAUNCHER`) | `singleTask`, `excludeFromRecents=true`, `configChanges="uiMode"` | `app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml` |
| `FakeHomeActivity` | `android.intent.action.MAIN` (`HOME`, `DEFAULT`, `LAUNCHER`) | `enabled="false"`, `exported="false"`; toggled briefly to reset default launcher | `AndroidManifest.xml`, `FakeHomeActivity.kt` |
| `PinItemActivity` | `CONFIRM_PIN_SHORTCUT`, `CONFIRM_PIN_APPWIDGET` | `LauncherApps.getPinItemRequest(intent)`; delegates widgets (API 26+) to `ForkWidgetPinDelegate` | `AndroidManifest.xml`, `PinItemActivity.kt` |
| `DeviceAdmin` | `android.app.action.DEVICE_ADMIN_ENABLED` | `BIND_DEVICE_ADMIN`, `meta-data` `@xml/policies` | `AndroidManifest.xml`, `DeviceAdmin.kt` |
| `MyAccessibilityService` | `android.accessibilityservice.AccessibilityService` | `BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICE`, `:serviceProcess`, `@xml/accessibility_service_config`, `label="@string/fork_app_name"` | `AndroidManifest.xml`, `MyAccessibilityService.kt` |
| `ForkWidgetPinDelegate` | `ACTION_APPWIDGET_PICK` (`1901`), `ACTION_APPWIDGET_BIND` (`1902`/`1904`), configure (`1903`/`1905`) | `EXTRA_APPWIDGET_ID`, `EXTRA_APPWIDGET_PROVIDER`, `EXTRA_APPWIDGET_PROVIDER_PROFILE`, `EXTRA_APPWIDGET_OPTIONS` | `ForkWidgetPinDelegate.kt` |
| `MainActivity` receiver | `ACTION_PROFILE_AVAILABLE`, `ACTION_PROFILE_UNAVAILABLE` | Dynamic receiver registered on `VANILLA_ICE_CREAM`+ for Private Space updates | `MainActivity.kt` |

### Outbound HTTP endpoints

| Method | Target URL | Auth | Request / Response | Fallback / Error handling | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `Constants.URL_WALLPAPERS` (`https://gist.githubusercontent.com/tanujnotes/85e2d0343ace71e76615ac346fbff82b/raw`) | None | Response JSON keyed by `"0_<daysSinceFirstOpen>"` (`< 10` days) or `"<M>_<d>"` containing stringified JSON with `"light"` and `"dark"` image URLs | Falls back to `Constants.URL_DEFAULT_LIGHT_WALLPAPER` or `Constants.URL_DEFAULT_DARK_WALLPAPER` | `Utils.kt`, `Constants.kt` |
| `GET` | Resolved wallpaper image URL | None | `HttpURLConnection` stream decoded via `BitmapFactory.decodeStream` | Returns `null` -> `setWallpaper` returns `false` -> `WallpaperWorker` returns `Result.retry()` | `Utils.kt`, `WallpaperWorker.kt` |

Observed `URL_WALLPAPERS` lookup payload shape (`Utils.kt` `getTodaysWallpaper`):

```json
{
  "0_0": "{\"light\":\"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1515549832467-8783363e19b6\",\"dark\":\"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1512551980832-13df02babc9e\"}"
}
```

Observed `FORK_WIDGET_ENTRIES` JSON contract (`ForkWidgetEntryJson` / `ForkWidgetPrefsTest.kt`):

```json
[
  {
    "appWidgetId": 42,
    "colSpan": 4,
    "rowSpan": 2,
    "order": 0,
    "minColSpan": 2,
    "minRowSpan": 1,
    "resizeMode": 3
  },
  {
    "appWidgetId": 105,
    "colSpan": 2,
    "rowSpan": 3,
    "order": 1,
    "minColSpan": 1,
    "minRowSpan": 2,
    "resizeMode": 0
  }
]
```

### Message formats

- **WorkManager periodic task**: `Constants.WALLPAPER_WORKER_NAME` schedules `WallpaperWorker` every `4` hours with `NetworkType.CONNECTED`, `ExistingPeriodicWorkPolicy.CANCEL_AND_REENQUEUE`, and `BackoffPolicy.LINEAR` (`1` hour) (`MainViewModel.kt`).
- **System callbacks & internal events**: `LauncherApps.Callback.onShortcutsChanged` triggers `MainViewModel.getAppList()` (`MainActivity.kt`); `SingleLiveEvent<T>` delivers one-shot UI events (`showDialog`, `checkForMessages`, `resetLauncherLiveData`); `ForkWidgetHostManager.notifyWidgetsChanged()` syncs host listening state and notifies registered `WidgetsFragment` listeners.
